chapters.reason: The paper explicitly investigates the micro-level functional differentiation of layers, identifying distinct roles for attention heads in the initial vs. later halves of the model.
The study analyzes how information flows across layers and identifies parallel pathways of answer generation, which aligns with the theory of information flow.
The paper identifies a functional rift in the middle layers, characterizing them as the transition point where the model shifts from pretraining priors to in-context reasoning.
